title: 'no' string not translated in initial calibration dialog box
body:
Version of xDrip: 2101081940

### Expected behavior
Code should use translated string instead of native english string.

### Actual behavior
'NO' is displayed instead of translatef string 'NON' in case of french language for current screenshots exemple

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start New sensor menu
2. Wait for readings...
3. Dialog box will be prompted asking to calibrate
